paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
suggested_experiment_name: Compilation (CAST + Haloscopes + Globular clusters + Solar nu, adapted from AxionLimits; Fig. 1 of Saikawa-Redondo-Vaquero-Kaltschmidt string simulation paper)
coupling_convention: Dimensionless axion-photon coupling C_agamma as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1 (C_agamma relates to g_agamma via g = alpha*C_agamma/(2*pi*f_a)); values emitted exactly as plotted, NOT converted to GeV^-1
notes: This is a theoretical prediction, not an experimental exclusion. Large-scale lattice simulations (up to 11264^3) of global string networks in the post-inflationary PQ scenario predict the QCD axion dark matter mass range m_a ~ 95-450 ueV (Eq. 1.2). The two data points mark the endpoints of this predicted band on the f_a-m_a plane; f_a values were computed by me from the standard QCD axion mass-decay constant relation (not directly quoted in the extracted text). No coupling constant (g_agamma etc.) is constrained; the result lives on the f_a-m_a plane, matching the AxionMass type. The range reflects extrapolation/systematic uncertainty rather than a formal statistical confidence level.
